color.note: One theme: Midnight Card Room. The accent colour is swapped every round to follow the trump suit (accent-spades, -diamonds, -clubs, -hearts).

tokens.name: felt-950
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen (the card-room felt). Never replace with pure black.

tokens.name: felt-900
tokens.usage: Lower stop of the table felt gradient and sheet backgrounds.

tokens.name: felt-800
tokens.usage: Top-centre radial glow behind each screen.

tokens.name: felt-table
tokens.usage: Upper stop of the oval table gradient.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass panel fill (6% white) with 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text on felt. Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions and secondary text on felt (about 8:1 on felt-950).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose; never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Gold gradient start: crown, dealer token, headings, winner.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Solid gold fallback: table rim, leader outline.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Missed bids, negative points. Always paired with a sign or a mark, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Dealer lock, over/under meter, validation messages.

tokens.name: accent-spades
tokens.usage: Trump accent while Spades are trump (ice blue). Drives glows, selected pills, primary button, table rim.

tokens.name: accent-diamonds
tokens.usage: Trump accent while Diamonds are trump (ruby-amber).

tokens.name: accent-clubs
tokens.usage: Trump accent while Clubs are trump (electric violet).

tokens.name: accent-hearts
tokens.usage: Trump accent while Hearts are trump (crimson-rose).

tokens.name: suit-black
tokens.usage: Symbol colour for spades and clubs on dark grounds.

tokens.name: suit-red
tokens.usage: Symbol colour for diamonds and hearts on dark grounds.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent, gold and positive fills (dark ink for contrast).

styles.name: hero-number
styles.usage: Big scores and the in-play trump count. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: player-name
styles.usage: Names in rows and the leaderboard.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest allowed text. Never go below 13px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between pills and chips.

tokens.name: actionbar
tokens.usage: Sticky bottom action bar including safe area.

tokens.name: glow-spades
tokens.usage: Panel glow while Spades are trump.

tokens.name: glow-diamonds
tokens.usage: Panel glow while Diamonds are trump.

tokens.name: glow-clubs
tokens.usage: Panel glow while Clubs are trump.

tokens.name: glow-hearts
tokens.usage: Panel glow while Hearts are trump.
